caption: The drawing features a central depiction of a small, round, wooden table with a light brown color and a subtle wood grain texture. The tabletop is circular, prominently placed in the upper center of the composition, and supported by a lathe-turned column that extends downward. Three curved, tapering legs radiate outward from the central column, each ending in a stylized foot. The drawing includes fine line detailing to indicate wood texture and shadow. In the lower left corner, there is a smaller, simplified black line drawing that shows a front view of the table with the tabletop in a vertical position, indicating its tilting function. In the lower right corner, another smaller black line drawing shows a side view of the table with the top in a horizontal position. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details.
title: Crow's Nest Tilt Top Table
